## Description

FORMULARY_ITEM per tenant and country: generic (INN), strength, form, brands, national code (UAE drug code), regulatory class (India Schedule H/H1/X; UAE controlled), ATC, default sig, status. Seed from the chosen data source; admin can add a medicine (validated) and build order sets (e.g. "Diabetes review labs"). Medicines not in the formulary can be prescribed as free text, flagged for review.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The data source and licence for each country are decided and recorded in an ADR before seeding (dependency 1 closed).
- [ ] **AC2.** Search by generic or brand returns strength/form options in < 300 ms.
- [ ] **AC3.** Controlled/scheduled classes are labelled and drive print requirements (e.g. Schedule H warning text).
- [ ] **AC4.** Admin-added medicines are audited and marked "clinic-added".
- [ ] **AC5.** Order sets can be created and used in the order composer.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
